verdicts.reason: Both use the same weak skeleton. The house photo is a small block at the top, followed by huge dead white bands above and below a small 'Mile Construction' title that sits almost against the left edge. The pool photo has shrunk to a tiny chip at the bottom, so the second key image is effectively lost. A is slightly worse because its bottom row splits into three scattered fragments: a beige block, the pool chip and a stray beige bar against the right edge. B at least layers the pool photo onto its beige panel the way the original does, though it is still tiny and cramped.
